name: BPR-RGA
description: "BPR-RGA is a benchmark for natural-language retrieval of reusable game assets at the asset-pack level. Each retrieval target is a pack that may contain multiple images, character sprites, interface elements, tilesets, textures, 3D resources, music tracks, or sound effects. Queries express game-development requirements involving asset type, appearance, style, intended function, scene context, musical characteristics, or sound events. Relevance is assessed at the pack level and may be supported by the pack as a whole or by a meaningful subset of its contents.The full benchmark contains 7,948 asset packs curated from OpenGameArt entries identified as CC0. It covers ten primary asset types: 2D characters, 2D environments, 2D animations, user interfaces, icons, tilesets, textures, 3D models, music, and sound effects. The gallery manifest contains 217,109 media-item records, comprising 212,135 images, 933 rendered previews, and 4,041 audio items. Asset metadata and media manifests preserve the relationships between each pack and its available constituent content.The full benchmark includes 600 natural-language queries, partitioned into 320 training queries, 80 validation queries, and 200 test queries. These partitions are disjoint at the query level and share the same asset corpus. The current versioned relevance files contain 124,033 judgment records: 39,269 for training, 9,603 for validation, and 75,161 in the current v6 test labels.
